entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Didja have trouble
getting
across
that
narrow
path?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_01

entries.text: There it is...the Dreaded Den. This is s’posed to\nbe the ogre’s home...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_02

entries.text: At least, that’s what everyone says. I come here\nall the time, but I’VE never seen it...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_03

entries.text: Maybe a powerful ogre like that would only show\nup if it heard some kinda battle goin’ on...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_04

entries.text: O-oh yeah... I think I’ve gotten a bit stronger\nsince the last time we battled, so...y’know...\r\nif you wanted to...we could battle?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_05

entries.text: Let’s do it!
entries.label: sdc01_0105_select_01

entries.text: I don’t know...
entries.label: sdc01_0105_select_02

entries.text: All right! Though, uh, we should heal up our\nteams first.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_06

entries.text: C’mon... I’ll even heal up your Pokémon for you\nfirst, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. So please...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_07

entries.text: I’ll give it all I got. I-I got this![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_08

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I knew it... You really are strong,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
How
am
I
ever
gonna
be
able
to
beat
you?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_09

entries.text: If the ogre saw that battle, I’m sure it’d be\nthinking, “That kid’s got real strength...”[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_37

entries.text: See, my school...Blueberry Academy...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_10

entries.text: It’s a school that specializes in teachin’ the art of\nPokémon battlin’.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_11

entries.text: If I was as strong as you...maybe I could aim to\nbe the best Trainer there.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_12

entries.text: Let’s go have a look at the ogre’s den.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_13

entries.text: Watch your head.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_14

entries.text: See how dark it is in here? And cramped...\nEven the floor’s all rough and uneven.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_15

entries.text: Living all alone in a place like this would get\npretty miserable, don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_16

entries.text: Poor ogre... We have plenty of room at our\nhouse. I would’ve totally let it stay with us...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_17

entries.text: You’re a sweet kid, Kieran
entries.label: sdc01_0105_select_03

entries.text: When can I move in?
entries.label: sdc01_0105_select_04

entries.text: N-no, I’m not! I’ve just...always liked the stories\nabout the ogre, that’s all...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_18

entries.text: I don’t know if we’d have room for the both of\nyou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_19

entries.text: B-but...if the ogre really did show up to stay at\nour place, I’m sure the whole town would freak.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_20

entries.text: Whoa, no way... The sun’s already gone down?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_21

entries.text: I guess we’ll have to save the last signboard for\ntomorrow...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_22

entries.text: Oh! I almost forgot!\c\nToday’s the first day of the Festival of Masks\nover at Kitakami Hall.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_23

entries.text: It’s this big event where everyone puts on masks\nand runs around celebratin’...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_24

entries.text: I mean, it’s not like you’ve gotta go or anything,\nbut if you wanted to...y’know...check it out...\r\nwell, it’d be fun.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_25

entries.text: Let’s go together!
entries.label: sdc01_0105_select_05

entries.text: It does sound fun
entries.label: sdc01_0105_select_06

entries.text: Y-yeah! Why not![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_26

entries.text: I, um...I can show you to it![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_27

entries.text: It’d be great to go together...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_28

entries.text: There’s just a few things we’d have to get ready\nfirst, so we should swing by my house before\r\nheading to the festival.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_29

entries.text: [EMPTY 43]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_30

entries.text: We live in the northwest corner of the village.\nIt’s...um...let’s see, I could maybe draw a map...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_31

entries.text: Oh, your Rotom Phone has a map in it, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_32

entries.text: You want me to register it on your map? Yeah,\nI could give that a try...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_33

entries.text: Wowzers! It sure is handy having a map that\nshows you everything right there in your phone...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_34

entries.text: I’m gonna ask if I can get a Rotom Phone\nsomeday too![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_35

entries.text: I’ll be right behind you, if you wanna head to my\nfamily’s place first. See you there![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0105_brother_36
